examples.turoyo: Hiye ínaqqa du+Sayfo d̥šamәʕ u+ʕamo kané quṭli a+mšiḥoye, bdalle dәmtaksi harke ruḥayye.
examples.translation: It, at the time of the Genocide, when the people heard that they were killing Christians, they began to prepare themselves (Dayroyo Aziz)
examples.raw: Hiye ínaqqa du+Sayfo d̥šamәʕ u+ʕamo kané quṭli a+mšiḥoye, bdalle dәmtaksi harke ruḥayye. It, at the time of the Genocide, when the people heard that they were killing Christians, they began to prepare themselves (Dayroyo Aziz)

examples.turoyo: Mtakasli u+kṯowo du+qerowo šan i+ṣluṯo dyawme dḥušabo
examples.translation: I prepared the book for the Sunday service
examples.raw: Mtakasli u+kṯowo du+qerowo šan i+ṣluṯo dyawme dḥušabo ‘I prepared the book for the Sunday service’ (Ilyas p.c.)
